csv_project_name: A/E Service for Huntsville Transit Electric Bus Chargers
csv_scope_of_work: This RFQ is for architectural and engineering consulting services for the design and construction administration of the Huntsville Transit Electric Bus Chargers project, including a Site Master Plan and construction of up to six Electric Bus Chargers at the Huntsville Parking & Public Transit Department site. The City of Huntsville is requesting qualifications from architectural and engineering firms describing the experience, education, and credentials of their firm for providing the design and construction administration services for the Huntsville Transit Electric Bus Chargers located at 500-B Church Street, Huntsville, Alabama 35801. This project includes the design and construction administration services for a Site Master Plan and the construction of up to six 6 Electric Bus Chargers to be located on the site of the Huntsville Parking & Public Transit Department, 500-B Church Street, Huntsville, Alabama 35801.
